name: tail127-position-mask

train.score_invariance: Exact equality of every predictive ngram and emission count; therefore all fixed-key scores are identical
train.mask_rule: Original position mask stays fixed; alternate grouping never re-masks

test.score_invariance: Exact equality of every predictive ngram and emission count; therefore all fixed-key scores are identical
test.mask_rule: Original position mask stays fixed; alternate grouping never re-masks

rng_order: labels; all train/test emissions; all visual groups; all masks
whole_word_metric: Only letters and both bracketing true spaces predictable within one physical row
warning: Calibration truth only. Solver must receive cipher segments and aggregate counts, never plain/true_labels/groups/true_key.
